title: Couscous Salad with Chicken & Pomegranate
description: Fluffy couscous tossed with grilled chicken, pomegranate seeds, mint and a lemon dressing.
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Prepare the couscous per packet instructions, then fluff with a fork.
Toss the couscous with oil, lemon juice, herbs and pomegranate seeds, and top with the chicken.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Mediterranean recipe collection

notes: Pomegranate seeds add a genuine pop of sweetness and crunch without any added sugar.
